descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S02 「现成的 spec：养老院 dashboard 数完整的名单并保持实时（只看实时性和总数）」 Existing spec: Nursing Home dashboard counts the whole roster and stays live (liveness and totals only)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U4 With the dashboard open, the counts update without a page reload when a note is generated or an encounter is completed（UAT TC-20；TFA-92598 AC 3；TFA-92598 How it works 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T3 The app counts every patient in Total and in exactly one of Pending (not yet prepped), In Progress and Complete, and shows the counts prominently（TFA-92598 How it works 1；TFA-92598 How it works 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Tim's resident test account. 50 filler residents plus the target, all created with inTodaysSession false, plus one patient in Hospital

When Open /snf, tap Dashboard. A second client moves the target through every status up to complete, resets it, removes it and adds another resident

Then Same assertions as S01 on /snf/dashboard

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in rounding-dashboard.spec.ts. Its residents are not In Today, yet the test expects them counted. That contradicts U5 (TFA-92598 AC 4, TFA-92587 AC 6): a Pass here is counter-evidence for U5 and is not evidence for U2 or U5. It proves liveness and totals only. The spec is expected to start failing once TFA-92598 AC 4 is built; …

在哪跑：dev 上的 datasets（种数据集跑列表）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S02 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev，lane datasets（datasets/results.json，截图不附）。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev/datasets。
